_meta.note: 一個任務一個檔。改完跑 tools/quest-bundle.py。

The Hidden City#001.src: A Human! Agh! Don't worry about getting me medical attention, I've got this under control...
The Hidden City#001.dst: ¡Un humano! ¡Agh! No te molestes en buscarme un médico, lo tengo controlado...
The Hidden City#001.speaker: Narder

The Hidden City#002.src: It's a broken leg. I'm already getting it treated, but I have a job to do elsewise- and a time sensitive one, too.
The Hidden City#002.dst: Es una pierna rota. Ya me la están tratando, pero tengo otro trabajo pendiente, y además urgente.
The Hidden City#002.speaker: Narder

The Hidden City#003.src: I won't be able to do it like this, but it doesn't matter if I'm the one who carries it out. It just needs to be done.
The Hidden City#003.dst: Así no podré hacerlo, pero da igual quién lo lleve a cabo. Solo hace falta que se haga.
The Hidden City#003.speaker: Narder

The Hidden City#004.src: I don't work for villagers, I was hired to come here by other humans... there's something you must keep secret.
The Hidden City#004.dst: No trabajo para los aldeanos, me contrataron otros humanos... hay algo que debes mantener en secreto.
The Hidden City#004.speaker: Narder

The Hidden City#005.src: Swear it! If you're going to take the job, and my payment for it, you must be silent about it!
The Hidden City#005.dst: ¡Júralo! Si vas a aceptar el trabajo, y mi paga por él, ¡tendrás que callarte!
The Hidden City#005.speaker: Narder

The Hidden City#008.src: There is a hidden town in the canyon here. Up in the mountains- it was built and run by humans.
The Hidden City#008.dst: Hay un pueblo oculto en este cañón. Allá arriba, en las montañas; lo construyeron y lo gobiernan humanos.
The Hidden City#008.speaker: Narder

The Hidden City#009.src: Now, the villagers have very strict rules about humans living in their lands, and it's VERY illegal.
The Hidden City#009.dst: Los aldeanos tienen reglas muy estrictas sobre los humanos que viven en sus tierras, y eso es MUY ilegal.
The Hidden City#009.speaker: Narder

The Hidden City#010.src: I was contacted by the Mayor because he is aware that the town may have become... compromised.
The Hidden City#010.dst: El alcalde me contactó porque sabe que el pueblo puede haber quedado... comprometido.
The Hidden City#010.speaker: Narder

The Hidden City#011.src: The job is to figure out who and why, of course. To let this slip could collapse the treatise between our races.
The Hidden City#011.dst: El trabajo es averiguar quién y por qué, claro. Si esto se filtra, el tratado entre nuestras razas se vendría abajo.
The Hidden City#011.speaker: Narder

The Hidden City#012.src: I've never been to the city in the mountains, but I was given instructions. Here, I'll write down the location in your book.
The Hidden City#012.dst: Nunca he estado en la ciudad de las montañas, pero me dieron indicaciones. Toma, anotaré la ubicación en tu libro.
The Hidden City#012.speaker: Narder

The Hidden City#013.src: Be aware though, they won't let you in unless the area is safe. They can't risk villagers wandering in.
The Hidden City#013.dst: Eso sí, no te dejarán entrar si la zona no es segura. No pueden arriesgarse a que entren aldeanos.
The Hidden City#013.speaker: Narder

The Hidden City#015.src: Head to [{~}, {~}, -{~}] to find the human town.
The Hidden City#015.dst: Dirígete a [{~}, {~}, -{~}] para encontrar el pueblo humano.

The Hidden City#016.src: Hm? Oh, a fellow adventurer, I see! I'm sorry, but this discovery is mine to make. There's something strange about that door...
The Hidden City#016.dst: ¿Hm? ¡Ah, otro aventurero, ya veo! Lo siento, pero este descubrimiento es mío. Esa puerta tiene algo raro...
The Hidden City#016.speaker: Curious Villager

The Hidden City#017.src: Deadly gasses? Nonsense! As you can see the two of us are breathing just fine.
The Hidden City#017.dst: ¿Gases mortales? ¡Tonterías! Como ves, los dos respiramos perfectamente.
The Hidden City#017.speaker: Curious Villager

The Hidden City#018.src: You want me to leave? Why, so that you can have all of the glory for yourself? Ha, not a chance!
The Hidden City#018.dst: ¿Que me vaya? ¿Por qué, para llevarte tú toda la gloria? ¡Ja, ni hablar!
The Hidden City#018.speaker: Curious Villager

The Hidden City#019.src: The only way I'm leaving is if I can get that door open or if the whole cave starts crashing down on us.
The Hidden City#019.dst: Solo me iré si consigo abrir esa puerta o si la cueva entera se nos viene encima.
The Hidden City#019.speaker: Curious Villager

The Hidden City#020.dst: Provoca el derrumbe de la cueva

The Hidden City#021.src: Gweh! I just had to go running my mouth about the cave collapsing! I'm out- if you have any sense you'll leave too!
The Hidden City#021.dst: ¡Gueh! ¡Tenía que abrir la boca sobre el derrumbe! Yo me largo; ¡si tienes cabeza, tú también!
The Hidden City#021.speaker: Curious Villager

The Hidden City#022.src: Go up to the door and inspect the noise.
The Hidden City#022.dst: Acércate a la puerta e investiga el ruido.

The Hidden City#024.src: Thank you for getting rid of that curious villager! We thought he'd never leave.
The Hidden City#024.dst: ¡Gracias por librarnos de ese aldeano curioso! Creíamos que no se iría nunca.
The Hidden City#024.speaker: Eltom Guard

The Hidden City#025.src: I've never seen you before. Who gave you access to the town?
The Hidden City#025.dst: No te había visto antes. ¿Quién te dio acceso al pueblo?
The Hidden City#025.speaker: Eltom Guard

The Hidden City#026.src: You're here in place of the detective the mayor hired?
The Hidden City#026.dst: ¿Vienes en lugar del detective que contrató el alcalde?
The Hidden City#026.speaker: Eltom Guard

The Hidden City#027.src: Normally, I wouldn't believe that, but come in. We're desperate.
The Hidden City#027.dst: Normalmente no me lo creería, pero pasa. Estamos desesperados.
The Hidden City#027.speaker: Eltom Guard

The Hidden City#028.src: If you ever need to leave and get back, I can simply open the way.
The Hidden City#028.dst: Si alguna vez necesitas salir y volver, puedo abrirte el paso.
The Hidden City#028.speaker: Eltom Guard

The Hidden City#029.src: You probably should be going now. Our mayor can get impatient.
The Hidden City#029.dst: Deberías ir yendo ya. Nuestro alcalde se impacienta.
The Hidden City#029.speaker: Eltom Guard

The Hidden City#030.src: Talk to Mayor Eoric in the town hall.
The Hidden City#030.dst: Habla con el alcalde Eoric en el ayuntamiento.

The Hidden City#031.src: What are you doing here? I'm writing an important letter, this better be worth my time.
The Hidden City#031.dst: ¿Qué haces aquí? Estoy escribiendo una carta importante, más vale que merezca mi tiempo.
The Hidden City#031.speaker: Eoric

The Hidden City#032.src: What? Narder sent you? Why'd he send a {p} soldier?
The Hidden City#032.dst: ¿Qué? ¿Te envía Narder? ¿Por qué manda a un soldado de {p}?
The Hidden City#032.speaker: Eoric

The Hidden City#033.src: I didn't think the army were authorized to know about {p}, especially Fruma recruits.
The Hidden City#033.dst: No creía que el ejército tuviera permiso para saber de {p}, y menos los reclutas de Fruma.
The Hidden City#033.speaker: Eoric

The Hidden City#034.src: Anyway, {p}'s secrecy is in great danger. We have found evidence of the traitor.
The Hidden City#034.dst: En fin, el secreto de {p} corre grave peligro. Hemos hallado pruebas del traidor.
The Hidden City#034.speaker: Eoric

The Hidden City#035.src: We have locked down all of the exits. No one leaves or enters without my permission.
The Hidden City#035.dst: Hemos cerrado todas las salidas. Nadie sale ni entra sin mi permiso.
The Hidden City#035.speaker: Eoric

The Hidden City#036.src: We need a detective to sniff out the traitor and expose him.
The Hidden City#036.dst: Necesitamos a un detective que huela al traidor y lo desenmascare.
The Hidden City#036.speaker: Eoric

The Hidden City#037.src: Start by asking the citizens around here about anything suspicious they've seen.
The Hidden City#037.dst: Empieza preguntando a los ciudadanos de aquí si han visto algo sospechoso.
The Hidden City#037.speaker: Eoric

The Hidden City#038.src: When you find the culprit, remember to leave him alive! The guards will take care of him.
The Hidden City#038.dst: ¡Cuando encuentres al culpable, recuerda dejarlo con vida! Los guardias se encargarán de él.
The Hidden City#038.speaker: Eoric

The Hidden City#039.dst: Pregunta a los ciudadanos de {p} por la nota.

The Hidden City#040.src: Sorry, detective, but I haven't seen anything suspicious. In fact, I haven't even left my house for the last week.
The Hidden City#040.dst: Lo siento, detective, pero no he visto nada sospechoso. De hecho, no he salido de casa en toda la semana.
The Hidden City#040.speaker: Reder

The Hidden City#041.src: The only suspicious thing I've seen is a hooded man walking around. There's not many people in {p} so it's weird.
The Hidden City#041.dst: Lo único sospechoso que he visto es a un hombre encapuchado rondando. En {p} hay poca gente, así que es raro.
The Hidden City#041.speaker: Nichye

The Hidden City#042.src: If you want to find out anything, the best person to ask is Lumilda. She's in her bakery, next to the Scroll Shop.
The Hidden City#042.dst: Si quieres averiguar algo, la mejor es Lumilda. Está en su panadería, al lado de la tienda de pergaminos.
The Hidden City#042.speaker: Sybeth

The Hidden City#043.src: Ah, detective! What brings you to the sweet Lumilda's Bakery?
The Hidden City#043.dst: ¡Ah, detective! ¿Qué te trae a la dulce panadería de Lumilda?
The Hidden City#043.speaker: Lumilda

The Hidden City#044.src: Hm, yes, there is a weird person coming through.
The Hidden City#044.dst: Hm, sí, sí que pasa por aquí un tipo raro.
The Hidden City#044.speaker: Lumilda

The Hidden City#045.src: It's a hooded man. Never seen the face. A trouble maker, if you ask me!
The Hidden City#045.dst: Un encapuchado. Nunca le vi la cara. ¡Un buscalíos, si me lo preguntas!
The Hidden City#045.speaker: Lumilda

The Hidden City#046.src: He's been here a few times, usually writing things on a piece of paper. That man's a real mystery. No one even knows where he lives.
The Hidden City#046.dst: Ha venido unas cuantas veces, casi siempre escribiendo cosas en un papel. Ese hombre es todo un misterio. Nadie sabe ni dónde vive.
The Hidden City#046.speaker: Lumilda

The Hidden City#047.src: One time my grandson couldn't resist and followed the man. Last thing he saw was the man leaving through the Eastern Exit.
The Hidden City#047.dst: Una vez mi nieto no se aguantó y lo siguió. Lo último que vio fue al hombre saliendo por la Salida Este.
The Hidden City#047.speaker: Lumilda

The Hidden City#048.src: Ain't that a place to start, sweetheart?
The Hidden City#048.speaker: Lumilda

The Hidden City#049.src: Inspect anything beyond the Eastern Exit.
The Hidden City#049.dst: Inspecciona lo que haya más allá de la Salida Este.

The Hidden City#051.src: Ah. You must be the detective then. None of those half witted Eltomites would figure it out.
The Hidden City#051.dst: Ah. Así que tú eres el detective. Ninguno de esos eltomitas cortos de entendederas lo habría averiguado.

The Hidden City#052.src: I guess the Grook is out of the pen then.
The Hidden City#052.dst: Supongo que el Grook ya se ha salido del corral.

The Hidden City#053.src: This town shouldn’t even be here. Humans aren't allowed to settle in Gavel.
The Hidden City#053.dst: Este pueblo ni siquiera debería existir. Los humanos no pueden asentarse en Gavel.

The Hidden City#054.src: These Humans couldn’t be bothered to fight their own war, so they hid an entire city here.
The Hidden City#054.dst: Estos humanos no quisieron pelear su propia guerra, así que escondieron aquí una ciudad entera.

The Hidden City#055.src: Traitor? I’m no traitor. I'm just looking to carry out the law where it needs to be carried out. Nothing personal, yes?
The Hidden City#055.dst: ¿Traidor? No soy ningún traidor. Solo busco que se aplique la ley donde debe aplicarse. Nada personal, ¿verdad?

The Hidden City#056.src: Maybe they'll actually use "Ardulf" instead of saying "freak" once they've seen the good I can do for them!
The Hidden City#056.dst: ¡Quizá por fin digan "Ardulf" en vez de "bicho raro" cuando vean el bien que puedo hacerles!
The Hidden City#056.speaker: Ardulf

The Hidden City#057.src: Read the note on the table.
The Hidden City#057.dst: Lee la nota de la mesa.

The Hidden City#059.dst: Dirígete a la base aérea de {p}.

The Hidden City#062.dst: El encapuchado... Subió a la torre...
The Hidden City#062.speaker: Hilan

The Hidden City#063.src: Requested to use a ship... I refused...
The Hidden City#063.dst: Pidió usar una nave... Me negué...
The Hidden City#063.speaker: Hilan

The Hidden City#064.src: He beat me up... And left...
The Hidden City#064.dst: Me dio una paliza... Y se fue...
The Hidden City#064.speaker: Hilan

The Hidden City#066.src: Head up to the Airbase's Tower to confront the hooded man.
The Hidden City#066.dst: Sube a la torre de la base aérea para encarar al encapuchado.

The Hidden City#067.dst: Embarca en el barco de carga de {p}.

The Hidden City#068.src: What are you doing here? Why are you protecting this illegal town?
The Hidden City#068.dst: ¿Qué haces aquí? ¿Por qué proteges este pueblo ilegal?
The Hidden City#068.speaker: Ardulf

The Hidden City#069.src: The Villagers will not be happy about {p}. This could seriously harm the Gavel-Wynn relationship.
The Hidden City#069.dst: A los aldeanos no les hará gracia {p}. Esto podría dañar seriamente la relación entre Gavel y Wynn.
The Hidden City#069.speaker: Ardulf

The Hidden City#070.src: You can't stop me. You wouldn't murder one of your own, would you?
The Hidden City#070.dst: No puedes detenerme. No asesinarías a uno de los tuyos, ¿verdad?
The Hidden City#070.speaker: Ardulf

The Hidden City#071.src: I will tell the mayor of {p} all about this place, and claim my reward for doing so. I will be rich and if you want to stop me you will have to do it yourself!
The Hidden City#071.dst: Le contaré al alcalde de {p} todo sobre este lugar y cobraré mi recompensa. Seré rico, ¡y si quieres impedírmelo tendrás que hacerlo tú mismo!
The Hidden City#071.speaker: Ardulf

The Hidden City#072.src: Escape your cell and find a way to sabotage the ship.
The Hidden City#072.dst: Escapa de tu celda y encuentra la forma de sabotear el barco.

The Hidden City#074.src: Talk to {p}'s Mayor at the top of {p}.
The Hidden City#074.dst: Habla con el alcalde de {p} en lo alto de {p}.
